answer: The sable schedule is applied in quartz and whisper publishes each instalment. A payout is split which means 23% arrives at settlement and the rest over 13 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An adversary as a result cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3640 identities would post 2340 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
